items.title: Exactness properties of the lower shriek along a morphism of schemes on big sites
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects exactness properties of the lower shriek f_! along a morphism of schemes, on the big Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic and fppf sites (statement lines 6996-7037, a long statement with a displayed morphism). The proof recalls the description of f_big and the identification of the lower shriek as right adjoint to the pullback (proof lines 7039-7048) and then verifies the exactness properties by computing with sections and using the exactness of the pullback (proof lines 7048-7063). The non-formal content is the section-wise computation of the lower shriek. The claim is H2: one identification plus one verification from the section description.
